title: 1. UN invasion traps Reds in Korea 2. UN Allied Forces close giant trap on Korean Reds 3. Orient at the crossroads (Extr
summary: Extracts from Movietone News newsreels relating to the war in Korea September to October 1950. 1. (1 min 36 sec). Coverage of the landings at Inchon, Korea 15 September 1950 by the X US Corps. Shows the naval bombardment by rocket ships and battleships of Task Force 77. The landing by US marines. Fleeing Korean civilians and a UN refugee camp south of Taegu. Republic of Korea troops on the move. 2
